title: A Holiday in London
setting: Busy streets in central London with tall buildings and a green park.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

sentences.en: Ben and Lily are on holiday in London.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) smile near a tall stone clock tower and a red double-decker bus.

sentences.en: At home, they live in a small village.
sentences.zh: 在家里，他们住在一个小村庄。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) wave in front of a few small cottages among green fields.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children in a small village; 'at home' (as opposed to London) can't be shown.

sentences.en: London is a very big and busy city.
sentences.zh: 伦敦是一座又大又繁忙的城市。
sentences.scene_prompt: A wide view of a big busy city with tall buildings, many people, cars and red buses.

sentences.en: They stay in a flat on a busy street.
sentences.zh: 他们住在一条热闹街道上的一套公寓里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) look out of a flat window at a busy street below.

sentences.en: In the town centre, they find a post office.
sentences.zh: 在市中心，他们找到了一家邮局。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) walk up to a post office with a red post box outside, in the middle of a busy town square.

sentences.en: Ben sends a postcard to Grandma Rosa's house.
sentences.zh: 本给罗莎奶奶家寄了一张明信片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) drops a postcard with a picture of a red bus into a red post box while Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) watches.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben posting a postcard; that it goes to Grandma Rosa's house can't be shown.

sentences.en: Workers build a tall building in this area.
sentences.zh: 工人们在这个地区建一栋高楼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) watch workers in hard hats build a tall building with a crane.

sentences.en: Then they rest in a big green park.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在一个绿油油的大公园里休息。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) sit on the grass under a tree in a big green park.
